name: Olaf
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: According to a report by Cointelegraph, the cryptocurrency venture capital firm Polychain Capital has confirmed that its founder and CEO, Olaf Carlson-Wee, has had his Twitter account compromised. Hackers have posted phishing links containing false airdrops. Polychain has urged Twitter users to avoid interacting with Carlson-Wee's account until further notice.
